text.tspan: APLD: revenue growth is not all recurring rent
FY27Q1 ended 31 August 2026 | HPC revenue USD 262.6 million | Base rent: 25.1%
Group cash, separately: operating cash 63.921 - asset purchases 2,074.698 = -2,010.777 (USD million).
Bars show segment revenue; the calculation is a simple group cash bridge, not segment profit or company-defined FCF.
The additional 75MW delivered on 1 October is a subsequent event; serviceable capacity is not actual power use or utilization.
Sources: Applied Digital FY27Q1 results and Form 10-Q cash-flow statement.
